name: Inner Mongolia Junzheng Energy & Chemical Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Inner Mongolia Junzheng Energy & Chemical Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the production of chemical products and chemical raw materials in China. The company offers polyvinyl chloride resin, caustic soda, calcium carbide, ferrosilicon, coal, coke, methanol, resin, paste resin, sodium hydroxide, cement clinker; 1, 4-butanediol, polytetramethylene ether glycol, methyl cetate, and crude methanol; ferrosilicon, calcium carbide, and white ash; and coke, coking coal, methanol, crude benzene, sulfuric acid, coal tar, ammonium sulfate, and chemical regeneration salt.
